{{Vanilla|Ocean Ruins}}
'''Ocean ruins''' generate as in vanilla. [[Matcha Flavoured]] changes their chest and [[archaeology]] loot, adding [[Nautilus Shell|nautilus shells]] and [[Trident]]s. The [[Archaeologist]] sells Warm Ocean Ruin Maps at level 3.
